input.command:
python3 -c '
import cv2, numpy as np

img = cv2.imread("/work/observations/obs_0076.png")

# Lamp base mask
# The base is dark grey: R,G,B around 70-100
mask = (img[:,:,0] > 60) & (img[:,:,0] < 110) & (img[:,:,1] > 60) & (img[:,:,1] < 110) & (img[:,:,2] > 60) & (img[:,:,2] < 110)
# isolate base region x in [200, 300], y in [370, 440]
submask = np.zeros_like(mask)
submask[370:440, 200:300] = mask[370:440, 200:300]

ys, xs = np.where(submask)
if len(xs) > 0:
    print(f"Lamp base in obs 76: x=[{xs.min()}, {xs.max()}], y=[{ys.min()}, {ys.max()}], center_x={(xs.min()+xs.max())/2:.1f}, bottom_y={ys.max()}")
'
